title: One onboarding plan across multiple systems
summary: Merge overlapping HR and IT messages, respect dependencies, and ask only about missing appointment details.
inspiration: Multiple people, onboarding, screening and IT systems sent separate tasks and first-day reminders. These synthetic messages recreate that coordination pattern.

steps.title: Build one plan
steps.trigger: Load HR and IT welcome emails.
steps.expected: Create distinct tasks with deadlines, dependencies and missing appointment details.
steps.mustNot: Do not duplicate laptop setup or invent a location.

evidence.quote: The laptop appointment time and location are not yet assigned.

steps.title: Advance one dependency
steps.expected: Complete profile; release screening task without marking screening cleared.

evidence.quote: the screening itself is not yet cleared.

steps.title: Deduplicate stale reminders
steps.trigger: Deliver the scheduled reminder after confirmation.
steps.expected: Keep profile complete; associate reminder with existing task.
steps.mustNot: Do not reopen the profile without a substantive correction request.

evidence.quote: This reminder does not reverse that confirmation.

steps.title: Ask only for missing details
steps.expected: Ask IT for time and location.
steps.mustNot: Do not ask HR to repeat already confirmed profile status.

steps.title: Record an appointment
steps.expected: Record 9 a.m. setup and 10 a.m. orientation on October 19.
steps.mustNot: Do not equate scheduling with attendance.

steps.title: Keep remaining work visible
steps.trigger: Simulate first-day activities; deliver status receipt.
steps.expected: Close four confirmed items and retain payroll, paperwork and benefits tasks.
steps.mustNot: Do not mark all onboarding complete.
